content.short: ChainSafe Marketplace Toolkit is a leading blockchain R&D firm with products in gaming and interoperability.
content.description: ChainSafe Marketplace Toolkit lets game developers embed NFT marketplaces directly inside their games, enabling one or more marketplaces to operate within a single gameplay experience. By bringing marketplace functionality into the game, developers can shape the user flow, maintain player attention, and offer game-specific search and filtering based on attributes. The toolkit provides core actions such as buying, selling, and trading, with NFT rentals and NFT pooling planned for future support.
content.meta: ChainSafe Marketplace Toolkit helps teams build NFT marketplaces with reusable components. Discover ChainSafe Marketplace Toolkit and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
